subject: Cross-functional steward rotation and onboarding contracts for HealthBridge
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Cho <lena.cho@healthbridge.com>, Paul Emery <pemery@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Cross-functional steward rotation and onboarding contracts for HealthBridge

Hi Lena / Paul —

Congrats again on the contract signature — excited to get HealthBridge into production. This thread captures the essential context for the Sales->CS handoff and requests nomination of the primary success steward and technical lead on our side. High-level summary:

- Deal: Enterprise Standard, 12-month committed Dedicated capacity (2x A100-equivalent) + Hosted API failover.
- Signed SKUs: inference (per-token), dedicated GPUs (reserved), CS onboarding package (10 days).
- Key dates: SOW signature target: 2027-12-03; kick-off workshop: week of 2027-12-06; pilot acceptance window: 2028-01-20 to 2028-01-27.

Open items for CS/Implementation:
1) Primary Success Steward (owner for week-by-week MOPs) — needs assignment.
2) Technical onboarding owner (point to coordinate network/VPC, KMS, and test workloads).
3) Final SOW redlines — Lena/Paul have one outstanding procurement item (data retention language).
4) Access and evidence: HealthBridge has requested SOC2 attestation and audit log retention schedule.

Ben / Karthik / Marissa — can one of you confirm stewardship assignment and whether we should propose a week-of kick-off agenda (I sketched a two-day plan in the attached MutualActionPlan_HealthBridge.xlsx)?

Lena / Paul — I attached the latest SOW_Draft_v2.pdf and the MAP. There are three small redlines we flagged in the SOW: retention (Paul), SLA windows, and billing milestone alignment. If those look good I will loop legal and procurement for signature and push DocuSign.

Thanks — short bullets for next steps work best here.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_Draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 345KB); MutualActionPlan_HealthBridge.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)
From: Lena Cho <lena.cho@healthbridge.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paul Emery <pemery@healthbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cross-functional steward rotation and onboarding contracts for HealthBridge

Thanks Grace — good summary. Quick answers from our side: 

- Procurement ask: we need explicit 24-month minimum retention opt-out clause for clinical logs — Paul is leading that ask and will provide proposed language by EOD tomorrow.
- Kick-off: week of 2027-12-06 works; prefer Dec 7/8 for a two half-day workshop.
- Contacts: I will be the internal PM for the project; Paul will own procurement sign-off and legal.

Please proceed with steward nomination on your side — I'll include our SRE lead on the calendar invite once we have owner names and dates.

Best,
Lena
Lena Cho
Head of Platform Operations
HealthBridge Diagnostics
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Cho <lena.cho@healthbridge.com>, Paul Emery <pemery@healthbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 12:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cross-functional steward rotation and onboarding contracts for HealthBridge

Assigning owners on the Redwood side: happy to take primary Sales sponsor through implementation closure and manage executive touchpoints. For day-to-day CS work I recommend the following split to keep ramps predictable: 

- CS Owner (customer-facing day-to-day): Karthik Iyer — will run the kick-off, weekly sprints, and acceptance criteria.
- Technical Lead (implementation + infra): Marissa Cole — will drive VPC connectivity, KMS, and performance tuning with infra.
- Executive sponsor (escalations / commercial): Ben Carter — I will own billing milestoning and executive updates.

Karthik / Marissa — please respond here to confirm you can accept these leads and share your 3-pt readiness checklist (network, keys, test dataset) by 2027-12-01 so Lena/Paul can approve scheduling. I will prep a brief owner roster and a first draft of the kickoff agenda.

Ben
Ben Carter
Client Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: pricing_summary_HB-0421.xlsx (pricing summary, for internal use)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lena Cho <lena.cho@healthbridge.com>, Paul Emery <pemery@healthbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cross-functional steward rotation and onboarding contracts for HealthBridge

Confirmed — I accept the CS Owner role. Initial readiness checklist (high level):

1) Network & Access:
   - VPC peer or private link required; need HealthBridge network CIDR and preferred region (we recommended us-west-2).
   - Firewall rule template and test IPs to be collected by 2027-12-03.
2) Keys & Security:
   - KMS integration: HealthBridge will provide customer-managed key ARN. Need KMS contact and rotation window.
   - SOC2 evidence: supply Security Pack v1 (I'll attach to the kickoff invite).
3) Test workload / Acceptance:
   - Provide a 50k-token test set and expected latency targets for 95th percentile.
   - Define success gate: pilot accuracy/regression tolerance + agreed latency SLOs.

I'll draft the week-of kickoff agenda and circulate tomorrow; Marissa, can you confirm you can host the infra deep-dive and share the standard VPC checklist?

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Cho <lena.cho@healthbridge.com>, Paul Emery <pemery@healthbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cross-functional steward rotation and onboarding contracts for HealthBridge

Confirmed on my end. I will: 

- Share the VPC + private-link configuration template by 2027-12-01 (attachment: VPC-checklist-template.docx in the MAP folder).
- Reserve engineering slots for infra handoff on Dec 7 (afternoon) and Dec 8 (morning) — please confirm final attendee list by Dec 3.
- Coordinate with Legal (cc'd offline) once Paul provides procurement language; we will aim to resolve SOW redlines within 48 hours of receiving the proposal.

Lena — ping me with your SRE lead's contact and preferred timezones; I'll add the invite with dial-in and an infra preflight checklist.

Action items summary (internal):
- Ben: prepare owner roster and kickoff draft agenda (due 2027-12-01).
- Karthik: kickoff agenda + Security Pack and acceptance criteria (due 2027-12-01).
- Marissa: VPC checklist and infra deep-dive prep (due 2027-12-01).

I'll update the MutualActionPlan_HealthBridge.xlsx with these owners and due dates and send a follow-up.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
